description: CommandPalette — ⌘K search and command box: a modal search field over grouped results. Built from Dialog, Kbd and the Combobox listbox pattern. Items are plain data; the palette filters, groups (in first-seen order) and navigates them, and calls `onSelect` with the chosen item. `open` is controlled; the ⌘K / Ctrl+K hotkey calls `onOpenChange` unless `hotkey={false}`. An item with `args` is a multi-step command: picking it does not run it. Instead the palette walks its arguments in order — the command and each chosen argument show as Tag chips before the field — and only then calls `onSelect(item, args)` with a record of argument id to chosen value (an option's id, or the typed text for a free-text argument). Backspace on an empty field, or a chip's remove button, steps back. <CommandPalette open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} items={commands} onSelect={(item) => run(item.id)} />

props.name: onSelect
props.type: (item: CommandPaletteItem, args?: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined) => void

usage.when: Let people jump to a page or run a command from anywhere by typing, opened with ⌘K or Ctrl+K.
usage.whenNot: Picking a value for a form field, or a short action list on a button.

useInstead.reason: picking a value for a form field
a short action list from a trigger
